kpis.label: Total Outstanding
kpis.interpretation: 119 open invoices across 34 customers. +USD 368.5K (+30.4%) vs last week
kpis.definition: Sum of outstanding_amount of all unsettled invoices (excluding cancelled and written-off), converted to reporting currency.

kpis.label: Overdue Outstanding
kpis.interpretation: 29.3% of total is past due. +USD 106.2K (+29.8%) vs last week
kpis.definition: Outstanding where due_date < reference date and outstanding_amount > 0.

kpis.label: Due Within 7 Days
kpis.interpretation: Not yet due; must be collected next week to avoid new overdue
kpis.definition: Outstanding of invoices not yet overdue whose due_date is within the next 7 days.

kpis.label: Collected This Week
kpis.interpretation: Applied cash received in the report week. -USD 160.8K (-71.4%) vs last week
kpis.definition: Sum of applied_amount of payments dated inside the report week (unapplied cash excluded).

kpis.label: New Overdue This Week
kpis.definition: Outstanding of invoices that were not overdue in the previous snapshot and are overdue now.

kpis.label: Broken Promises
kpis.interpretation: 2 customer(s) missed a promised payment date
kpis.definition: Promised amount not received by the promised_payment_date (uncompleted promise activities).

kpis.label: At-Risk Amount
kpis.definition: Union of: 30+ days overdue, disputed invoices, and all open invoices of customers with a broken promise or an exceeded credit limit.
